instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide, eye-level shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpeted floor, white walls, and wall-mounted cameras. The man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, leaning forward and extending his right arm to touch the shoulder of the woman. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing left with a neutral expression. There are no bystanders in the room. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.

R2 is the recipient of R1's shoulder touch
